currency_note: All prices in USD unless an entry has a "currency" field; those are converted to USD on load using data/fx.json.

entries.label: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
entries.notes: Paid tier, standard text pricing. Batch $0.15 in / $1.25 out. Cached input $0.03 (implicit caching; the caching page lists no minimum for Flash-Lite, so the 4,096 tokens stated for Gemini 3.x Flash is assumed). Cache storage per hour not modelled.

entries.label: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash
entries.notes: Paid tier from 1 January 2027 (introductory $0.75 in / $3.75 out through 31 December 2026; the later price is used because it applies to almost all of a 36-month plan). Batch $0.75 in / $3.75 out. Cached input $0.15; minimum 4,096 input tokens. Cache storage per hour not modelled.

entries.label: Google Gemini 4 Argon
entries.notes: Paid tier from 1 December 2026 (introductory $2 in / $10 out through 30 November 2026; the later price is used). Output includes thinking tokens. Batch $2 in / $10 out. Cached input $0.20 (implicit caching only); minimum 4,096 input tokens.

entries.label: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna
entries.notes: Standard, short-context prices. Batch $0.05 in / $0.25 out. Cached input $0.01; minimum cacheable prompt 1,024 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input for 30 minutes, not modelled.

entries.label: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra
entries.notes: Standard, short-context prices. Batch $0.50 in / $2.50 out. Cached input $0.05 (0.05× input); minimum cacheable prompt 1,024 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input, not modelled.

entries.label: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.notes: Standard, short-context prices (GPT-6 Astra is a higher tier at $10 / $50). Batch $1 in / $5 out. Cached input $0.10; minimum cacheable prompt 1,024 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input, not modelled.

entries.label: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5
entries.notes: Prompts up to 100,000 tokens (longer prompts cost $0.50 in / $2.50 out). Batch $0.05 in / $0.25 out. Cache hits $0.01; minimum cacheable prompt 512 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input, not modelled.

entries.label: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5
entries.notes: Batch $1 in / $5 out. Cache hits $0.10 (0.05× input); minimum cacheable prompt 512 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input, not modelled.

entries.label: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5
entries.notes: Claude Fable 5.1 is a higher tier at $10 / $50. Batch $2 in / $10 out. Cache hits $0.20 (0.05× input); minimum cacheable prompt 512 tokens. Cache writes cost 1.25× input, not modelled.

entries.label: Mistral Small 4
entries.notes: Standard prices. Cached input $0.015; no minimum prompt size is stated. Batch prices are not listed on the static page, so standard prices are used for batch work.

entries.label: Mistral Large 4
entries.notes: Mistral's top generalist model (Medium 3.5 is deprecated in its favour). Mistral has no model in the premium role, so it is not a candidate at the best quality level. Cached input $0.07; no minimum prompt size is stated. Batch prices not listed; standard prices are used.

entries.label: Qwen3.5 9B on DeepInfra
entries.notes: Open-weight ~9B model, bf16, served per token. Same size class as the self-hosted small model. No cached or batch price listed.

entries.label: Gemma 4 31B on DeepInfra
entries.notes: Open-weight 31B model (gemma-4-31B-it, fp8), served per token. Same size class as the self-hosted medium model. No cached or batch price listed.

entries.label: Llama 3.3 70B on DeepInfra
entries.notes: Open-weight 70B model (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo, fp8), served per token. Same size class as the self-hosted large model; newer, larger open models cost more (e.g. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B at $0.45 / $3.00). No cached or batch price listed.

entries.label: L4 throughput assumption (~8B open model, batched serving)
entries.notes: ASSUMPTION, not a vendor price. Aggregate output tokens/sec with batching; benchmark on your own model. Prompt reading (prefill): L4 121 dense FP16 TFLOPS × 50% ÷ (2 × 8B parameters) ≈ 3,800 prompt tokens/sec; NVIDIA datasheet figures, utilisation assumed. Output tokens/sec is decode only.

entries.label: L40S throughput assumption (~32B 4-bit open model, batched serving)
entries.notes: ASSUMPTION, not a vendor price. Benchmark on your own model. Prompt reading (prefill): L40S 362 dense FP16 TFLOPS × 50% ÷ (2 × 32B parameters) ≈ 2,800 prompt tokens/sec (4-bit weights are computed at 16 bits); NVIDIA datasheet figures, utilisation assumed. Output tokens/sec is decode only.

entries.label: A100 80 GB throughput assumption (~70B 4-bit open model, batched serving)
entries.notes: ASSUMPTION, not a vendor price. Benchmark on your own model. Prompt reading (prefill): A100 312 dense FP16 TFLOPS × 50% ÷ (2 × 70B parameters) ≈ 1,100 prompt tokens/sec; NVIDIA datasheet figures, utilisation assumed. Output tokens/sec is decode only.
